title.b: What we have built so far.

intro: Our customers, our products, what we have done, and what we have achieved.

achieved.title: What we have achieved
achieved.text: The team brings more than 25 years of experience in software engineering. Our delivery center of excellence stands on five pillars: domain knowledge, technologies, skilled resources, engineering process, and project management.

stats.offices: Offices in the USA and Vietnam

done.title: What we have done
done.text: End-to-end software powered by AI and modern technologies across five service lines, from custom applications and system integration to scalable cloud solutions.

products.title: Products
products.text: Two products of our own for schools, built on the same engineering we bring to client work.

school.name: AI-powered platform for smart schools
school.text: An integrated digital ecosystem for schools: personalized learning paths, real-time analytics, automated grading, and smart resource management.

timetabling.name: AI-powered timetabling
timetabling.text: An intelligent scheduling system that automates the creation and optimization of academic timetables, and compares timetables built from different inputs and constraints.

customers.title: Customers
customers.text: Our domain knowledge runs deepest in three sectors. In October 2025, a client visited our Ho Chi Minh City delivery center to explore AI and robotics in education.

varkey.text: A K–12 school group based in Dubai.

projects.pxp: ParentXP, the app for parents. Its AI assistant, Nova, answers school questions and drafts emails to staff.

cyberhive.text: A firm that offers cybersecurity, risk, and privacy services.

projects.diagnostic: Cybersecurity assessments and compliance framework management.
projects.intel: Threat intelligence monitoring and dark web surveillance.
